subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary is a protected natural area in the Gulf of Mexico.
• It encompasses 56 square miles.
• The Flower Garden Banks sanctuary was established to protect the habitat of elkhorn coral, a threatened species.
• The Flower Garden Banks sanctuary is managed by NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration).
• NOAA restricts commercial fishing activities in the area.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the role NOAA plays in protecting the habitat of elkhorn coral. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: By restricting commercial fishing activities in the Flower Garden Banks sanctuary, NOAA protects the habitat of elkhorn coral.
choices.B: Commercial fishing activities are restricted in the Flower Garden Banks sanctuary, a protected natural area in the Gulf of Mexico.
choices.C: The 56-square-mile Flower Garden Banks sanctuary was established to protect the habitat of elkhorn coral, a threatened species.
choices.D: Home to elkhorn coral, the Flower Garden Banks sanctuary is located in the Gulf of Mexico, where it encompasses 56 square miles.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it directly emphasizes NOAA's protective role by making the agency the grammatical subject performing an action. The sentence uses a causal structure ('By restricting commercial fishing activities...NOAA protects') that explicitly connects NOAA's management action from note 5 to the conservation goal from note 3. This construction places NOAA at the center of the sentence and clearly attributes the protection of elkhorn coral habitat to their regulatory actions, effectively accomplishing the student's rhetorical goal.
